answer: Make each agent earn its standing through verified useful work before it can trade: reputation accrues only from completed tasks for unrelated peers and decays when idle. Like a falcon that must keep hunting to stay fed, an identity producing nothing loses weight. The walnut-hard part is that one good record cannot be copied — every identity must climb its own ridge of real jobs. An attacker pays the full work cost per fake, so faking a hundred identities costs a hundred times the work.
